# zhetri_3x

> Computes the inverse of a complex Hermitian indefinite matrix using the factorization produced by `zhetrf_rk` (worker routine called by `zhetri_3`).

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import zhetri3x from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/zhetri_3x';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
zhetri_3x( order, uplo, N, A, LDA, e, strideE, IPIV, strideIPIV, WORK, nb ) → integer
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | Storage layout (`'row-major'` or `'column-major'`) |
| `uplo` | `MatrixTriangle` | `'upper'` or `'lower'`, must match the factorization |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix `A`<br>Requires `N ≥ 0` |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>N × N</sub> | **in/out** · Input matrix (factored form from `zhetrf_rk`) |
| ↳ `LDA` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `A`<br>Requires `LDA ≥ max(1, N)` |
| `e` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Super- or sub-diagonal of the block diagonal matrix `D` |
| ↳ `strideE` | `integer` | Stride length for `e` |
| `IPIV` | `Int32Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Pivot indices from `zhetrf_rk` |
| ↳ `strideIPIV` | `integer` | Stride length for `IPIV` |
| `WORK` | `Complex128Array \| null`<br><sub>(N + nb + 1) × (nb + 3)</sub> | **out** · Workspace |
| `nb` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Block size |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies whether the details of the factorization are stored as an upper or lower triangular matrix.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.
- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `A`: On entry, diagonal of the block diagonal matrix D and factors U or L as computed by ZHETRF\_RK and ZHETRF\_BK:

  -   a) ONLY diagonal elements of the Hermitian block diagonal matrix D on the diagonal of A, i.e. $D(k,k) = A(k,k)$; (superdiagonal (or subdiagonal) elements of D should be provided on entry in array E), and
  -   b) If `UPLO = 'U'`: factor U in the superdiagonal part of A. If `UPLO = 'L'`: factor L in the subdiagonal part of A.

  On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the Hermitian inverse of the original matrix.

  -   If `UPLO = 'U'`: the upper triangular part of the inverse
  -   is formed and the part of A below the diagonal is not
  -   referenced;
  -   If `UPLO = 'L'`: the lower triangular part of the inverse
  -   is formed and the part of A above the diagonal is not
  -   referenced.
- `e`: On entry, contains the superdiagonal (or subdiagonal) elements of the Hermitian block diagonal matrix D with 1-by-1 or 2-by-2 diagonal blocks, where If `UPLO = 'U'`: $E(i) = D(i-1,i)$, $i=2$:N, `E(1)` not referenced; If `UPLO = 'L'`: $E(i) = D(i+1,i)$, $i=1$:N-1, `E(N)` not referenced.

  NOTE: For 1-by-1 diagonal block D(k), where $1 \le k \le N$, the element `E(k)` is not referenced in both `UPLO = 'U'` or `UPLO = 'L'` cases.
- `IPIV`: Details of the interchanges and the block structure of D as determined by ZHETRF\_RK or ZHETRF\_BK.
- `nb`: Block size.

</details>

**Returns** `integer`: status code (`0` = success; `> 0` = the `(k,k)` element of `D` is exactly zero so the inverse cannot be computed)

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order
- `TypeError` second argument must be a valid matrix triangle
- `RangeError` third argument must be a nonnegative integer
- `RangeError` fifth argument must be greater than or equal to `max( 1, N )`

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
zhetri_3x.ndarray(
    uplo,
    N,
    A, strideA1, strideA2, offsetA,
    e, strideE, offsetE,
    IPIV, strideIPIV, offsetIPIV,
    WORK, strideWork, offsetWork,
    nb
) → integer
```

Computes the inverse of a complex Hermitian indefinite matrix using the factorization produced by `zhetrf_rk` (worker routine called by `zhetri_3`), using alternative indexing semantics.

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `uplo` | `MatrixTriangle` | `'upper'` or `'lower'`, must match the factorization |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix `A`<br>Requires `N ≥ 0` |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>N × N</sub> | **in/out** · Input matrix (factored form from `zhetrf_rk`) |
| ↳ `strideA1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of `A` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideA2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of `A` (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetA` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `A` |
| `e` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Super- or sub-diagonal of the block diagonal matrix `D` |
| ↳ `strideE` | `integer` | Stride length for `e` |
| ↳ `offsetE` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `e` |
| `IPIV` | `Int32Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Pivot indices from `zhetrf_rk` |
| ↳ `strideIPIV` | `integer` | Stride length for `IPIV` |
| ↳ `offsetIPIV` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `IPIV` |
| `WORK` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>(N + nb + 1) × (nb + 3)</sub> | **out** · Workspace |
| ↳ `strideWork` | `integer` | Stride length for `WORK` |
| ↳ `offsetWork` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `WORK` |
| `nb` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Block size |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies whether the details of the factorization are stored as an upper or lower triangular matrix.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.
- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `A`: On entry, diagonal of the block diagonal matrix D and factors U or L as computed by ZHETRF\_RK and ZHETRF\_BK:

  -   a) ONLY diagonal elements of the Hermitian block diagonal matrix D on the diagonal of A, i.e. $D(k,k) = A(k,k)$; (superdiagonal (or subdiagonal) elements of D should be provided on entry in array E), and
  -   b) If `UPLO = 'U'`: factor U in the superdiagonal part of A. If `UPLO = 'L'`: factor L in the subdiagonal part of A.

  On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the Hermitian inverse of the original matrix.

  -   If `UPLO = 'U'`: the upper triangular part of the inverse
  -   is formed and the part of A below the diagonal is not
  -   referenced;
  -   If `UPLO = 'L'`: the lower triangular part of the inverse
  -   is formed and the part of A above the diagonal is not
  -   referenced.
- `e`: On entry, contains the superdiagonal (or subdiagonal) elements of the Hermitian block diagonal matrix D with 1-by-1 or 2-by-2 diagonal blocks, where If `UPLO = 'U'`: $E(i) = D(i-1,i)$, $i=2$:N, `E(1)` not referenced; If `UPLO = 'L'`: $E(i) = D(i+1,i)$, $i=1$:N-1, `E(N)` not referenced.

  NOTE: For 1-by-1 diagonal block D(k), where $1 \le k \le N$, the element `E(k)` is not referenced in both `UPLO = 'U'` or `UPLO = 'L'` cases.
- `IPIV`: Details of the interchanges and the block structure of D as determined by ZHETRF\_RK or ZHETRF\_BK.
- `nb`: Block size.

</details>

**Returns** `integer`: status code (`0` = success; `> 0` = the `(k,k)` element of `D` is exactly zero so the inverse cannot be computed)

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid matrix triangle
- `RangeError` second argument must be a nonnegative integer

### Status codes

An `info` status code: `0` on success. A positive value reports a numerical condition such as a singular pivot or a failure to converge (see the description). Invalid arguments throw instead of returning a negative `info`. Returns immediately when `N === 0`.

The reference documents `INFO` as:

-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, $D(i,i) = 0$; the matrix is singular and its inverse could not be computed.

</section>

## Notes

-   `zhetri_3x()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`ZHETRI_3X`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/zhetri_3x.f).

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Complex128Array from '@stdlib/array/complex128/lib/index.js';
import Int32Array from '@stdlib/array/int32/lib/index.js';
import zhetri3x from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/zhetri_3x';

// Trivial 1x1 example: the factored form of [[5+0i]] is itself, and its inverse is [[0.2+0i]].
const A = new Complex128Array( [ 5.0, 0.0 ] );
const e = new Complex128Array( 1 );
const ipiv = new Int32Array( [ 0 ] );
// WORK is (N+nb+1)-by-(nb+3): 12 elements for N = nb = 1.
const work = new Complex128Array( 12 );

const info = zhetri3x( 'column-major', 'lower', 1, A, 1, e, 1, ipiv, 1, work, 1 );
console.log( info ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
console.log( A.get( 0 ) ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<section class="reference-notes">

## Reference notes

The mathematical description from the reference LAPACK 3.12.0 source of `ZHETRI_3X`. Indices are the 1-based Fortran indices of the source.

### Purpose

ZHETRI\_3X computes the inverse of a complex Hermitian indefinite matrix A using the factorization computed by ZHETRF\_RK or ZHETRF\_BK:

$$
A = P \, U \, D \, (U^H) \, (P^T) \quad\text{or}\quad A = P \, L \, D \, (L^H) \, (P^T)
$$

where U (or L) is unit upper (or lower) triangular matrix, $U^H$ (or $L^H$) is the conjugate of U (or L), P is a permutation matrix, $P^T$ is the transpose of P, and D is Hermitian and block diagonal with 1-by-1 and 2-by-2 diagonal blocks.

This is the blocked version of the algorithm, calling Level 3 BLAS.

</section>
